payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over candidate strings in lexicographic order of increasing length, check if each candidate appears as substring in any given title; output first missing candidate.
payload.rationale: Solution performs a brute-force enumeration over the string space, generating candidates in lexicographic order and checking substring presence. Among provided subtypes, backtracking most closely captures the systematic candidate generation, though the implementation is iterative. No graph traversal, bitmask, permutation, or branch-and-bound used.
